scope: Resume only Qwen3 Coder and Qwen3.6 after preserved 180-second timeout; parent serial queue, unchanged 32-token prompt/settings.
prompt: Explain why the sky is blue in three short sentences.
load_policy: CLI LoadOptions draft=false,kv=(512,1),expert_bytes=None. Qwen35 maps None to0 expert cache; Qwen3Moe always streams experts, no device expert cache. StableLM packedweights +fp16KV. No server prompt-cache allocation.

argv: Explain why the sky is blue in three short sentences.
Explain why the sky is blue in three short sentences.

wrapper.direct_executable: $CLI (environment applied to wrapper/child; no nested shell or timeout)

output_contract.answer: stdout.log, preserve exact UTF8, may be truncated at32tokens or end earlier onEOS
output_contract.timing: stderr final [prompt N tokens in PPs; G generated in TGs (R tok/s)]
output_contract.prompt_tokens_per_second: N / printedPPseconds, approximate because PPseconds roundedto0.01
output_contract.generation_tokens_per_second: Use CLI printedR (computed from unrounded elapsed). Includes sampling/outputflush and first-token sample from prefetched logits; not pureGPUkernel throughput.
output_contract.time_to_first_token: Not separately measured by existingCLI; do not label PPtime as TTFT.
output_contract.success: Wrapperexit0/groupempty +one validtimingline +nonemptyanswer +1<=generated<=32 +finitepositivetimings +memorybounds +pins unchanged. No quality/numeric oracle PASS from plausibleanswer.
